# Goblin

A creature is a rules object the plugin describes in its own data pack rather than
in Go, so a different game can ship a different vocabulary without a client change.

| Trait | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Armour class | 15 |
| Hit dice | 2d6 |

Three of these are on the north road. See [[scene]], and
[[rules/poisoned|the poisoned condition]] they carry.
